RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  August 18, 2010/Sravana 27, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Road Transport and Highways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
106
Teenagers trained in Pakistan
arrested by J&K police
*341. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that J&K police
unearthed large stock of RDX, AK47 rifles,
detonators, hand grenades etc. during the
current year and also arrested some
teenagers trained in Pakistan by terrorists
groups;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether these facts have been
conveyed to the Government of Pakistan;
(d) if so, what is the reaction of that
Government; and
(e) what strategy is being evolved to
deal with the situation, if Pakistan does
not cooperate?
Prevention of atrocities on dalits
†*342. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that incidents of
massacre of dalits have increased
unprecedentedly in the country during the
recent years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has received
any suggestion to make amendment in
article 17 of the Constitution to prevent
atrocities on dalits in the country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Shortage of submarines
*343. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of submarines
available with the Indian Navy, category-
wise;
(b) whether there is a shortage of
submarines to guard the coasts of India;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Counting on the basis of religion in
Census 2010
*344. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Census is
being conducted in the country during 2010;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

107
(b) if so, whether there is any proposal
to count on the basis of religion; and
(c) if so, what are the reasons therefor
and the purpose to be achieved?
Ram Mohan Commission report on
maoist attack at CRPF camp
*345. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has received
the report of E.N. Ram Mohan Commission
on maoist attack at CRPF camp;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has taken any
action on this report?
Unauthorized occupation of DDA flats
*346. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Delhi Police have received
complaints regarding unauthorized
occupation of DDA Janta flats in Chilla
Village, Mayur Vihar, New Delhi by anti-
social elements;
(b) whether Human Rights Commission
and National Commission on Women have
also urged the Delhi Police for vacation of
flats of some women Government officials
being occupied unauthorizedly by anti-
social elements;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action taken to remove
unauthorized anti-social elements/
trespassers from the DDA flats in Mayur
Vihar, New Delhi?
Central assistance for construction/
maintenance of roads and bridges in
States
*347. SHRI G. N. RATANPURI: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of Central assistance
provided to each State for construction/
maintenance of roads and bridges during
the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the amount spent directly by
different Central Government departments
and agencies for construction of new roads
and bridges in each State during the last
three years, year-wise;
(c) the amount provided to Jammu and
Kashmir (district-wise) from Central Road
Fund and other Central loan, assistance and
grants during the last three years; and
(d) whether any priority is given to road
projects of J&K as in the absence of
Railways, the State is fully dependent on
roads?
Honour killings
*348. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether former Chief Justice of India
has described honour killings as human
rights violation;
(b) if so, whether Government has
decided to refer the issue of honour killings
to a Group of Ministers (GoM) under the
Chairmanship of Finance Minister to
consider the issue;
(c) if so, whether GoM has given its
recommendations;
(d) if so, the details thereof;

108
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) by when Government is considering
to introduce legislation in this regard; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Monitoring receipt and utilization of
foreign funds by NGOs
*349. SHRI RAMDAS AGARW AL:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Non-Government
Organisations (NGOs) which have been
receiving financial assistance from abroad
during the last three years, till-date, year-
wise and State-wise;
(b) whether Government has any
mechanism to monitor the receipt and
utilization of foreign funds by NGOs and
exercise any control over their annual
accounts;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether there are complaints of
corruption/irregularities in the monitoring
of foreign funds of NGOs resulting in
misutilization of such funds; and
(e) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and remedial measures taken in this
regard?
Amending Hindu Marriage Act to
tackle honour killings
*350. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to deal with the menace of honour killings;
(b) whether it is a fact that the incidents
of honour killings have caste dimension;
(c) whether Government thinks it
appropriate to enact separate legislation
for the purpose; and
(d) whether it is also a fact that
Government is thinking to amend Hindu
Marriage Act instead of passing separate
legislation?
Framing of rules on FTA
†*351. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the countries with which India has
entered into free trade agreement;
(b) whether Government proposes to
enter into Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with
some other countries;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the action plan in this regard and the
identified priority sectors;
(d) whether Government has made any
assessment of the effects of these FTA on
domestic industries and farmers;
(e) whether Government has framed
rules on FTA to maintain uninhibited trade
with other countries;
(f) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(g) if not, by when such rules are likely
to be framed and implemented?
New guidelines for arms licences in
Delhi
†*352. SHRI RASHEED MASOOD:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether to extend the validity of
arms licences in Delhi, the Ministry has
issued new guidelines superseding the
guidelines issued in 2009;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of guidelines in place at

109
present in Delhi for extending the validity
of arms licences across the country?
Clearing backlog of subsidies to tea
industry
*353. SHRI T. M. SELV A-
GANAPATHI: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has been urged to clear the sizable backlog
of subsidies to the tea industry;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
being taken by Government in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that India's
bias towards Crush, Tear, Curl (CTC) tea
had led to a steady erosion of its
international market; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
NHs in Haryana
*354. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of National Highways
(NHs) in Haryana;
(b) the details of those NHs which are
in poor/unsatisfactory condition;
(c) the amount earmarked and spent on
each of them during the last three years;
(d) the names of NHs in Haryana and
Punjab which require further widening and
development; and
(e) the target date set for the purpose?
Damage due to floods in Punjab and
Haryana
*355. SARDAR SUKHDEV SINGH
DHINDSA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Team which
visited Punjab and Haryana to assess the
damage due to floods caused by Ghaggar
river has submitted its report to
Government;
(b) if so, the details of the report; and
(c) the nature of assistance, financial
and otherwise, provided to the affected
States?
Setting up ITIs in LWE affected blocks
*356. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: W ill the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Orissa has
submitted the proposal for setting up 186
Industrial Training Institutes in Left Wing
Extremists (LWE) affected blocks of the
State, and if so, the action taken by
Government on the proposal; and
(b) in view of the urgent need for
providing employment to the youth in
these affected blocks, whether Government
proposes to treat this as a special package
for skill development and provide funds
liberally?
Probe into dumping of items by China
*357. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government has
initiated a probe into the alleged dumping

110
of several items by China after finding
"sufficient evidence" of injury to the
domestic players;
(b) if so, details of the dumping of items
came to the notice of the Government in
the past one year;
(c) whether the Government proposes
to take stringent steps to check such
dumping by China which is directly
affecting domestic industry; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Differences between CRPF and
Chhattisgarh police
*358. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there have been differences
between CRPF and the Chhattisgarh State
police authorities over the deployment of
paramilitary forces to combat the naxal
menace in the State;
(b) whether Government has decided
to revisit the deployment of CRPF
personnel in Chhattisgarh depending on
their operational or developmental
requirements; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Special train for defence personnel in
Gujarat
*359. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
a large number of defence and para-defence
personnel are posted at Jamnagar in
comparison to Ahmedabad as on date;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that Ministry of
Railways has announced a train
"Janambhoomi", specially meant for men
in uniform in the western region in the
Budget of 2010-11;
(d) if so, whether his Ministry has asked
Ministry of Railways to operate this train
from Jamnagar to Udhampur instead of
Ahmedabad to Udhampur; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Job loss due to global meltdown
*360. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
has suffered a huge job loss during the global
meltdown as it hit the country also;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government had made any
survey regarding the total job loss during
that period;
(d) if so, the details thereof with a list of
sectors and the number of jobs lost in each
sector;
(e) whether Government had made any
assessment regarding new jobs created in
the recent period of recovery; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 12th August, 2010 Secretary-General.
Sravana 21, 1932 (Saka)

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 351, 353, 357,
Defence : 343, 359,
Home Affairs : 341, 342, 344, 345, 346, 348, 349,
350, 352, 355, 358,
Labour and Employment : 356, 360,
Road Transport and Highways : 347, 354.
Textiles :—
GMGIPMRND—3680RS—12.08.2010.
